{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mandalorian Supremacists''' were a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] who considered all non-Mandalorians inferior. During [[Pol Temm]]'s tenure as eleventh [[Administrator/Legends|administrator]] of [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]], they attacked the [[Space station/Legends|station]] and destroyed Temm's [[Nebula-class Star Destroyer|''Defender''-class]] [[Star Destroyer]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] [[Gender/Legends|him]].
